requirement: A restore asks for its database before it stops the site or swaps the webroot

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: Review of the L13 fix, 05/10/2026: restore.sh waited for the database only at step 5, after step 2 had stopped the web container, step 3 replaced the webroot and step 4 changed the image, so a database that never came up (a password the volume does not know, a server that will not start) left a half-restored site serving nothing. Red d77ed59de, fix 7a21045f0.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 8). Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): restore.sh starts the db service and waits for it ('==> checking the database') right after the snapshot is fetched and DB_PASSWORD read; a database that never comes up ends the run there, before the web container is stopped, the webroot replaced or the image changed.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: restore: a database that never comes up stops the restore before the site is touched
tests: restore: a database that never comes up stops the restore before the site is touched
